content: uPlot (npm, 1.6.32): canvas-based real-time time-series chart. Benchmark (author-published): streaming 3600 pts at 60fps costs ~10% CPU/12.3MB RAM vs ~40%/77MB for Chart.js and ~70%/85MB for ECharts on the same task. Cold start renders 166,650 points in 25ms. No built-in pan/zoom (needs plugin). Recommended for scrolling multi-signal dashboards at 10-20Hz; Plotly.js is heavier/general-purpose and not a fit for a real-time strip chart.
